reason: A broad DeepSeek Harness enhancement suite primarily focused on native desktop integration and interface customization, with additional local document processing, workspace assistance, account usage reporting, and tool-approval behavior; human review is appropriate because of its elevated system, filesystem, and external-account capabilities.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生桌面应用、壁纸与透明度设置、桌宠、快捷栏，以及本地文档读取和个人助理等增强功能。
summaries.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness with a native desktop app, wallpaper and transparency controls, a desktop companion, quick-access controls, local document handling, and personal-assistant tools.

capabilities: Provides a native Electron desktop application with frameless, tray, auto-hide, and desktop-pet windows
Modifies the DeepSeek Harness interface with wallpaper, transparency, dock, settings, and desktop-pet features
Reads local Office documents in DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX formats with documented path and format checks
Writes assistant task, note, summary, meeting, and generated document files within a configured local workspace
Reads DeepSeek balance and session token usage through an external account API
Applies automatic approval to read-only tool calls and requires confirmation for write operations
Builds or restarts local backend and desktop application components during installation
